Credit grants: money or your own unit of credit, given as promotional credit or sold as paid credit. Grants pay usage lines on invoices in a fixed order, expire, and keep every change as a credit transaction.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/access`](/help/developers/api-reference/credits/check-access-by-usage-key) | Check access by usage key |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/credit_holds`](/help/developers/api-reference/credits/list-credit-holds) | List credit holds |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/credit_holds/{hold}`](/help/developers/api-reference/credits/retrieve-a-credit-hold) | Retrieve a credit hold |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/credit_holds/{hold}/capture`](/help/developers/api-reference/credits/capture-a-credit-hold) | Capture a credit hold |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/credit_holds/{hold}/release`](/help/developers/api-reference/credits/release-a-credit-hold) | Release a credit hold |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/credit_units`](/help/developers/api-reference/credits/list-credit-units) | List credit units |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/credit_units`](/help/developers/api-reference/credits/create-a-credit-unit) | Create a credit unit |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/credit_units/{unit}`](/help/developers/api-reference/credits/retrieve-a-credit-unit) | Retrieve a credit unit |

| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/credit_grants/{grant}`](/help/developers/api-reference/credits/retrieve-a-credit-grant) | Retrieve a credit grant |
